notes.title: You can pet the dog! (Update to v1.02)
notes.notes:
Hello friends and fans! This is a fairly minor update, but there were some issues I wanted to address with a patch update.

Notes:
[list]
[*] Changed some dialogue based on the order you do certain events.
[*] Removed some debug text that wasn't supposed to be seen by players.
[*] Added even more help to solving a late-game puzzle.
[/list]
And perhaps most importantly of all:
[list]
[*] [b]You can now pet the dog in Nacre.[/b]
[/list]
